your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Orange monopoly is the win. Med+$250 was rejected on strategy, not price; PA is the non-cash sweetener. If accepted, cash left $745: build 2 houses on each orange ($600), keep $145 buffer. Do not go to 3-each ($900). Green stays split (p1 has NC, Pacific unowned) so PA to p3 is not an instant monopoly — but they could flip PA to p1 for Oriental. Worth the risk only because orange with houses ends the game. If rejected, stop. Do not add NY or St James. Do not give p2 cash.

Stop chasing Tennessee. p3 will not hand me the orange set; adding NY or St James would be giving away the set pieces. Cash $845 survives one BW 2-house hit ($600) but not 3 houses. Do not give p2 any cash — $33 funds a dark-blue house. Do not trade PA or an orange unless I complete a set. Buy priorities: yellows (Atlantic/Marvin still bank; p1 only has Ventnor), Pacific (deny p1 a 2nd green; they have $378 and can buy it), Virginia (deny p1 pinks). No mortgage, no build.

No set, nothing to build or mortgage. Cash $861 must cover a BW 2-house hit ($600) and still buy Pacific ($300) or a yellow if I land. Do not give p2 cash — $200 funds a 3rd dark-blue house and bankrupts me. Do not trade PA to p1 (they have NC + $578 and only need Pacific). Do not chase Tennessee; p3 already refused completing my orange. Virginia now p2's, so p1 pinks are blocked unless they pay p2 — never fund that. Hold Med, both oranges, PA, and the jail card.

Reject. NC is 2/3 green only; Pacific still bank-owned and I'm in jail so I can't land on it. $325 leaves $536, short of BW 3-house ($850) and PP ($750). Worse: p1 has the pink monopoly and only $28 — any cash over ~$72 lets them build, and jail exit walks straight into pinks. Greens stay blocked anyway (p1 can't afford Pacific). Do not fund p1 or p2. Hold cash, both oranges, PA, Med, jail card. Stay in jail while blues/pinks are hot. Don't chase NC unless price is near $0 or doesn't fund a house.

Stay in jail. BW/PP at 3 houses bankrupts me from $875 (standard ~$1400/$1100; even the lower estimate of $850 leaves me dead if I pay $50 first). 5/6 I remain safe. Save the jail card for when blues cool or I need to buy Pacific/yellows. Do not fund p1 ($28, pinks with 1 house) or p2 ($17). Hold Med, both oranges, PA, cash.

Jail turn 2 of 3. BW/PP still 3 houses and p2 has $17 so they cannot add a 4th. Leaving now puts me on the circuit toward $1100/$1400 rents I cannot pay from $875. 5/6 I stay safe. Save the jail card for the forced third turn or a buy window (Pacific/yellows). Do not fund p1 or p2. Hold Med, both oranges, PA, cash.

Cap at $35 so p1 stays at $99 and cannot buy a $100 pink house. NC is only 2/3 green; Pacific unowned and I'm in jail so I can't complete it. $210 would fund two pink houses and drop me to $665, still dead to 3-house dark blue. If they refuse, do not raise. Hold jail card, Med, both oranges, PA, cash. Stay in jail.

Reject. $180 puts p1 at $244 and funds two pink houses; I drop to $695 with no set. NC is only 2/3 green, Pacific is bank-owned, and I'm in jail so I can't complete it. Their mortgage bluff ($150) gives them less cash and costs them the deed. Do not raise. Stay in jail, hold the card, Med, both oranges, PA, and cash. Don't fund p1 or p2.

Jail turn 2/3. BW/PP still 3 houses ($1400/$1100) and p2 now has $400 so they can even-build to 4 houses ($200 each). Either way a dark-blue hit bankrupts me from $875. Exit roll from jail only lands pinks/oranges (survivable) but starts the lap toward blues; no shot at unowned Atlantic/Pacific this roll. 5/6 stay safe. Save the card for the forced third turn. Do not fund p1 ($64, pinks) or p2. Hold Med, both oranges, PA, cash.

Out of jail on Penn RR, $775, jail card still in hand. No set, nothing to build. Next roll (2-12) stays in the safe band: my oranges, mortgaged reds, Illinois base $20, B&O $50. Cannot reach unowned Atlantic (13) or Pacific, or dark blue, this roll. p2 has PP/BW at 3 houses ($1100/$1400) and $400 — can hotel both; any cash I send them makes that worse. They will not sell Tennessee (completes my orange) or a dark blue. p1 has $114 and uneven pink houses; paying them funds a States house. Do not mortgage. Hold Med, both oranges, PA, card, cash. Buy Atlantic ($260) or Pacific ($300) if I land; never sell PA to p1. Only win path is completing orange or green cheaply enough to build before a dark-blue hit — not available this turn.
